messages:
release-checker-bot: preflight failure - env parity check failed for release window 2024-06-08T15:00Z
service=inference-router
check=model_cache_prefix_normalization
staging: "models/llama/v2/weights/"
prod:    "models/llama/v2/weights"
observed: canary requests returning ModelCacheLookup NOT_FOUND (s3 key mismatch)
reason: staging config has trailing slash, prod stripped it -> downstream cache keys differ
recommendation: hold promotion until either runtime normalizer or backfill applied

maria: pinging @cheng and @luis - can you triage? If it's just trailing slash we can either normalize keys at read time or backfill prod keys. Which is faster?

cheng: saw the same in canary. quick triage: it's deterministic mismatch during prefix concat in router config. We can add a simple normalize_prefix() in 10-20m and deploy a canary patch. Backfill script to copy keys from both forms will take longer (~45m) depending on S3 list perf.

luis: +1 to runtime normalization to unblock. But note: some downstream consumers store the full key as canonical (no slash) so normalization must be idempotent (strip or ensure single slash). Avoid double-slash.

sarah: can we keep current release pinned to previous image until canary validates the patch? We have a change window til 16:00Z.

maria: yes hold release for now. @release-checker-bot please pause promotion per policy.

release-checker-bot: Promotion paused by @maria (policy: preflight-fail). Release will not auto-promote.

cheng: creating PR now - runtime fix:
```python
def canonical_prefix(p):
    return p.rstrip('/') + '/'
```
This ensures all generated cache keys include one trailing slash. I'll push canary after PR merges.

maria: great. @ops-oncall can you watch errors during canary? If error rate > 1% rollback to pinned image.

ops-oncall: watching. will alert on >1% 5m window. setting alert threshold now.

luis: also adding small migration script to reconcile existing objects:
```bash
python backfill_prefixes.py --src-no-slash --dest-with-slash --dry-run
# then run without --dry-run after canary ok
```
Estimate 30-40m for small bucket.

cheng: PR merged, canary deploy triggered (image: inference-router:2024-06-08-hotfix-5829). Observability: enabled detailed cache key logging for 10m.

maria: thanks. leaving release on hold until canary looks healthy and backfill finishes. After canary + backfill we'll mark release ready and unpause. If anything unexpected, we'll roll back to inference-router:2024-06-stable.

ops-oncall: canary metrics show ModelCacheLookup NOT_FOUND drop from 12% -> 0.2% after patch (10m). No other errors.

maria: 👍 sounds good. I'll schedule a short postmortem doc for root-cause (config lint gap) and add a gating lint to catch prefix trailing-slash mismatches in future.

sarah: any release notes changes? Add note: "Fixed model cache prefix normalization to prevent missing model artifacts due to trailing-slash mismatch."

maria: will update release notes and unpause promotion once backfill completes and metrics stable for 15m.

cheng: backfill completed successfully. Verified keys accessible for both prefix forms. Canary stable.

maria: unpausing promotion and resuming release window. Thanks all.

release-checker-bot: Promotion resumed by @maria.
